xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4466: Needs-you shows subagent permission prompts with no way to answer them (answerable:false, no options, no explanation)

plan.title: Needs-you shows subagent permission prompts with no way to answer them (answerable:false, no options, no explanation)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A Claude Code permission prompt taller than the conversation's terminal (a 20-row Herdr viewport and a ~40-line subagent Bash command) loses its ─── rule and title off the top of the screen. parsePermissionPrompt requires that rule and returns null, so pendingPermission falls back to the hook registry with answerable:false and no options. The operator sees a Needs-you row with no buttons and no next step; the dialog's Open terminal lands on the chat view (no ?view=terminal, and CommandDeck ignores conversationViewMode); and the composer, which holds sends only for answerable prompts, can press Down/Enter into the prompt. The bug is about clipped prompts, not subagents: a main-agent prompt with a long command fails the same way.
narratives.Proposal: Teach the parser to accept a clipped prompt under stricter rules (question 'Do you want to …', Yes/[always]/No options with one cursor at the bottom, an 'Esc to cancel' footer, no rule in view) and mark it clipped with an unknown thread. Map clipped prompts in the feed as answerable with the registry's input preview, so the existing dialog and answer route work and the composer holds sends. Show the command start and visible tail in the dialog, put the next step and first command line on Needs-you and Decisions rows, make Open terminal (and a non-answerable row click) land on /conv/<name>?view=terminal, and make the Command Deck honor that view. Document the behavior in docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md, the codebase map and changelog.mdx.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing the Herdr or tmux pane height for conversations or agents
- Answering permission prompts for work, review or test agents (conversations only, as in PAN-4278)
- An inline expand/collapse control on the Needs-you row (the row click opens the dialog with the full command)
- Persisting the permission registry across dashboard restarts
- Telling several subagents' clipped prompts apart by matching the command tail
- Changes to the PAN-3113 pane-choice parser or the Codex/OpenCode permission paths
- Raising any row in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the parser to recognize clipped prompts instead of enlarging pane viewports.
autoDecisions.rationale: The prompt is on screen; only the parser is too strict. A taller pane only moves the threshold, since any long enough command clips any pane.

autoDecisions.summary: Clipped detection is not gated on a hook-registry entry.
autoDecisions.rationale: The registry empties on every dashboard restart, and the composer hold depends on detection: missing a prompt lets a send press keys into it, while a false positive only costs a button the answer route refuses with 409.

autoDecisions.summary: Clipped prompts are accepted only with the stricter rules: QUESTION_LINE question, Esc-to-cancel footer, no ─── rule within 40 lines above the question, plus every existing option/cursor/bottom-of-screen rule.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the parser's existing guarantee that it never offers keys to a pane that is not asking anything.

autoDecisions.summary: PermissionPrompt gains clipped:boolean; header and fromAgent are null when clipped and callers treat the thread as unknown, never main.
autoDecisions.rationale: fromAgent===null currently means 'main thread'; reusing it would mislabel a subagent prompt and clear the wrong registry entry.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Expandable' command on the Needs-you card means the row shows a truncated first line with the full text in its title attribute, and a click opens the dialog with the full command.
autoDecisions.rationale: The row is a button; nesting an expander inside it is invalid HTML, and the dialog already renders the full command.

autoDecisions.summary: A non-answerable Needs-you row navigates straight to /conv/<name>?view=terminal in one click; answerable rows keep navigate + reopen-dialog.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for a one-click Open in terminal when the dashboard cannot answer.

autoDecisions.summary: Next-step text goes into permissionSummary ('· click to answer' / '· answer in the terminal').
autoDecisions.rationale: Both the Needs-you row and the Decisions panel render permissionSummary, so one change covers both surfaces.

autoDecisions.summary: The command shown on rows prefers the registry input preview over the on-screen detail lines.
autoDecisions.rationale: The preview is the start of the command, which a clipped screen cannot show.
CommandDeck/index.tsx is 1608 lines against a 1612 cap; the deep-link fix needs room and agents may not raise allowlist rows.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item 1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4466.md). Create the fixture claude-code-2.1.284/permission-subagent-clipped.txt with the exact 20-line capture from the PRD's Root cause section. In permission-prompt.ts: make header string|null, add clipped:boolean, add CANCEL_HINT=/\besc to cancel\b/i, replace the rule search (grep anchor '// The prompt block starts under the nearest ─── rule above the question.') with the windowed search from the PRD; when no rule is found the prompt is clipped and is accepted only if the question matches QUESTION_LINE and a trailing line matches CANCEL_HINT. A clipped prompt has header=null, fromAgent=null, its whole window as detail/reason lines, and signature prefix '(clipped)'. Join │-prefixed lines that follow a reason into that reason (FR-3). Update the module header comment. Add the six tests named in the PRD.
